integrity: The 12 class counts are reconstructed from scratch by two exhaustive enumerations: all ordered ranking triples and all anonymous ranking multisets with exact multinomial weights. Tournament isomorphism classes are independently obtained by brute-force relabeling of all 1024 labeled five-vertex tournaments.
scientific_limitations: The result is a complete finite census for exactly three ordered voters and five strictly ranked alternatives under impartial culture. It records only the unweighted majority tournament, not pairwise margins, and makes no asymptotic claim.
title: Exact five-candidate majority-tournament fibers for three voters
